log_level.description: Global logging verbosity level. Choose from debug, info, warn, error.

home_dir.description: Base directory for multispeech data, including cache, voices, and logs.

default_engine.description: Default speech synthesis engine to use when none specified (flite, mbrola, pico, festival).

default_voice.description: Default voice language/variant (e.g., en-us, fr-fr, de-de). Must match voices supported by the default engine.

default_rate.description: Default speech rate in words per minute (typical range: 100–250).

default_pitch.description: Default pitch adjustment (0–99). Higher values = higher pitch. 50 is neutral.

default_volume.description: Default volume (0–100). 80 is loud but safe for most speakers.

threaded_render.description: Enable or disable multi-threaded rendering for concurrent jobs. Improves throughput on multi-core systems.

max_jobs.description: Maximum number of concurrent speech rendering jobs. Adjust based on CPU/memory capacity.

job_timeout.description: Maximum time (seconds) a rendering job may run before being terminated.

engines.description: Per-engine configuration blocks. Each engine has its own section with enable flag and paths.

flite.description: Configuration for FLITE (Fast Little ITU) TTS engine.

enabled.description: Enable FLITE engine (required for many basic English voices).

voices.description: List of FLITE voice identifiers available (e.g., en-us, en-gb, cmu-rms).

enabled.description: Enable MBROLA engine (requires external MBROLA binaries + voice data).

voice_dir.description: Directory containing MBROLA voice data files (.dbl).

voices.description: List of MBROLA voice identifiers (e.g., fr1 for French, de4 for German).

items.description: MBROLA voice ID, typically matching a .dbl file name without extension.

pico.description: Configuration for Pico TTS (e.g., from Android/Nuance).

enabled.description: Enable Pico TTS engine (lightweight, good for embedded use).

default_lang.description: Default language code used when none specified.

langs.description: List of language codes supported by the Pico installation.

festival.description: Configuration for Festival Speech Synthesis System.

server_binary.description: Path to the Festival server binary.

config_dir.description: Directory containing Festival init scripts and voice definitions.

server_host.description: Hostname or IP address Festival server listens on.

voices.description: List of voice identifiers available in Festival.

voice_aliases.description: Mapping of short, human-friendly voice aliases to engine+voice identifiers (e.g., 'en-male' → 'flite+cmu-rms').
